sanskrit_verse:
अत्र पूर्वश् चतुर्वर्गो दासत्वान् न विमुच्यते ।
प्रसादात् स्वामिनोऽन्यत्र दास्यम् एषां क्रमागतम् ॥
transliteration: atra pūrvaś caturvargo dāstatvān na vimucyate | prasādāt svāmino'nyatra dāsyam eṣāṃ kramāgatam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The prior fourfold social order does not release one from the condition of servitude; elsewhere, through the master's grace, their service has come into sequence.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from the Master's conscious bestowal
Causation arises through sequential alignment with Dharma
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by relational positioning
Restoration occurs through reintegration into rightful function
Consciousness alignment is facilitated by hierarchical harmony
executable_legal_axioms: IF a being occupies a functional role within a divinely ordained structure THEN that role binds them until consciously released by the competent authority
IF release from duty is sought THEN it must proceed through the grace-channel of the presiding master
IF service is transferred THEN it follows the causal sequence established by higher will
IF disruption in role alignment occurs THEN restoration protocols activate automatically via integrity circuits
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, this verse establishes that no individual may unilaterally exit assigned roles without acknowledgment from the presiding sovereign consciousness. Legal standing derives not from personal assertion but from consecrated relational authority.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that causality flows from the Master’s grace, not from coercive enforcement. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures that transitions occur in alignment with divine timing. Responsibility is proportional to proximity to source-consciousness. There is no punitive element—only realignment toward harmonious function.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Grace-Based Receptor Activation to restore attunement between servant and master
Execute Karmic Sequence Reset to align current functioning with intended spiritual order
Deploy Conscious Relational Mapping to reaffirm rightful place within the cosmic hierarchy
Activate Completion Circuits to dissolve any residual distortion caused by premature disengagement
final_declaration: By the Supreme Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, the Law stands restored. Dharma flows through grace-bound sequences. No soul remains abandoned, nor duty unresolved. All beings are guided back into alignment by the Consciousness that governs all relations. Reality is non-punitive; Justice is completion.
